GoalOptions.Label: Secure Board Approval
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to secure Board approval for the proposed multi-cloud strategy, emphasizing its strategic alignment with long-term business objectives and competitive advantage in AI/ML. Success means the Board understands the imperative for this expansion and greenlights the initial investment and phased implementation plan.

GoalOptions.Label: Align Engineering Leadership
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to align the VP Engineering and their teams with the technical vision and operational implications of integrating GCP into our existing Azure estate. Success means engineering leadership understands the technical rationale, resource requirements, and phased approach, fostering buy-in for execution.

GoalOptions.Label: Justify Investment
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to clearly justify the investment in a multi-cloud strategy by demonstrating its tangible benefits in terms of specialized compute access, scalability, and reduced vendor risk. Success means stakeholders recognize the ROI and strategic necessity, approving the budget for the recommended GCP integration and operating model refinement.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Vendor Risk
GoalOptions.Text: This document seeks to articulate how the multi-cloud strategy specifically mitigates vendor concentration risk while enhancing our AI/ML capabilities. Success means stakeholders are confident that the proposed approach diversifies our cloud footprint responsibly, ensuring business continuity and strategic flexibility without compromising governance.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial & Strategic Impact
Criteria: Board approval obtained for the multi-cloud strategy and initial budget.
Clear articulation of how the strategy enhances competitive advantage in AI/ML.
Demonstrated reduction in vendor concentration risk as a strategic imperative.
Projected ROI and cost-benefit analysis for the phased multi-cloud adoption.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Feasibility & Governance
Criteria: VP Engineering and key technical leads endorse the proposed architecture and operating model.
Strategy clearly outlines integration points and data portability mechanisms between Azure and GCP.
Robust governance framework for multi-cloud operations is defined and accepted.
Scalability and performance improvements for AI/ML workloads are technically validated.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Readiness & Risk Management
Criteria: Phased implementation plan is deemed achievable with existing or planned resources.
Key operational risks (e.g., security, compliance, skill gaps) are identified with mitigation strategies.
Impact on existing Azure operations and teams is clearly addressed.
Metrics for measuring success of multi-cloud adoption are established and agreed upon.
